content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Lemon Squeezy is a popular platform for creators, offering a range of features, including sales tracking, analytics, and user management. However, for restricted countries, it's essential to explore alternatives that provide similar functionalities without the limitations of Stripe. One such option is Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, offering a comprehensive digital commerce solution that enables creators to manage sales, track analytics, and automate delivery. Another option is the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which provides GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments, catering to creators who require a basic yet robust digital commerce infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

While Lemon Squeezy and other platforms like PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle, exclude certain countries from their services, alternatives like Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack are designed to overcome these restrictions. By leveraging free and paid tools, such as Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can establish a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that operates independently of Stripe and other conventional payment gateways. This means that creators in restricted countries can access a comprehensive digital commerce solution without relying on Stripe or other excluded platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack excel in comparison to Lemon Squeezy and other conventional platforms. With NOWPayments, creators can enjoy automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, significantly reducing transaction costs. Moreover, by leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, creators can achieve faster payment processing and lower fees associated with conventional payment gateways. This translates to increased revenue for creators and reduced operational costs.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the significant advantages of Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack lies in their ownership, automation, and delivery features. With these solutions, creators can maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce infrastructure, automating delivery and order management without relying on third-party services. This means that creators can focus on creating and marketing their products, while their digital commerce infrastructure operates seamlessly in the background, ensuring timely and efficient delivery of products to customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack depends on the specific needs and requirements of each creator. Edge Commerce Stack, priced at $197, offers a more advanced digital commerce solution, with features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. On the other hand, Sovereign Starter Stack, priced at $97, provides a basic yet robust infrastructure for creators who require a more straightforward solution. By considering their individual needs and goals, creators can choose the architecture that best suits their situation and establish a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that empowers them to succeed.
Who is the competitor of Lemon Squeezy?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
